original_text:
# Go wallet stealers retain useful application method names in pclntab even
# when the normal Mach-O symbol table has been stripped. Requiring browser
# profile discovery, multiple wallet extractors, and encrypted server posting
# captures the data flow without relying on an IOC or one vendor signature.
defaults:
  platforms: [macos]
  for: [macho]
  attack: T1555.003,T1005,T1041,T1132.001

traits:
  - id: go-browser-profile-discovery-methods
    desc: Go methods enumerate browser data and profiles
    crit: suspicious
    conf: 0.92
    count_min: 3
    if:
      type: text
      regex: 'main\.(getBrowserDataPath|getBrowsers|findBrowserProfiles|getProfilesByExtension)'

  - id: go-wallet-address-extractor-methods
    desc: Go methods extract addresses from multiple browser wallets
    crit: suspicious
    conf: 0.95
    count_min: 4
    if:
      type: text
      regex: 'crypto-bot/wallet\.ExtractAddressInfosFrom[A-Za-z0-9_]+'

  - id: go-encrypted-server-reporting-methods
    desc: Go methods encrypt and post collected data to a server
    crit: suspicious
    conf: 0.93
    count_min: 3
    if:
      type: text
      regex: 'main\.(postEncryptedData|postToServer|buildServerUrl)'

composite_rules:
  - id: go-browser-wallet-encrypted-exfiltration
    desc: Go binary discovers browser wallets and posts encrypted wallet data
    crit: hostile
    conf: 0.99
    all:
      - id: metadata/lang/compiler/systems::go-binary
      - id: go-browser-profile-discovery-methods
      - id: go-wallet-address-extractor-methods
      - id: go-encrypted-server-reporting-methods
    unless:
      - id: well-known/app/
      - id: well-known/tool/
intentional_change: Count distinct named profile/report methods rather than repeated matches of an alternation. Wallet address repetition count remains unchanged and does not count distinct providers.

objectives/exfiltration/stealer/wallet/g.content:
defaults:
  platforms:
  - macos
  for:
  - macho
  attack: T1555.003,T1005,T1041,T1132.001
composite_rules:
- id: go-browser-wallet-encrypted-exfiltration
  desc: Browser wallet data with encrypted reporting methods
  crit: hostile
  conf: 0.99
  all:
  - id: metadata/lang/compiler/systems::go-binary
  - id: micro-behaviors/fs/path/application/browser::go-browser-profile-discovery-methods
  - id: micro-behaviors/data/parse/wallet::go-wallet-address-extractor-methods
  - id: micro-behaviors/communications/http/telemetry::go-encrypted-server-reporting-methods
  unless:
  - id: well-known/app/
  - id: well-known/tool/

micro-behaviors/fs/path/application/brow.content:
defaults:
  platforms:
  - macos
  for:
  - macho
  attack: T1555.003,T1005,T1041,T1132.001
traits:
- id: go-browser-data-path-method
  desc: Browser data path method reference
  crit: notable
  conf: 0.92
  if:
    type: text
    substr: main.getBrowserDataPath
- id: go-browser-browsers-method
  desc: Browser enumeration method reference
  crit: notable
  conf: 0.92
  if:
    type: text
    substr: main.getBrowsers
- id: go-browser-profiles-method
  desc: Browser profile search method reference
  crit: notable
  conf: 0.92
  if:
    type: text
    substr: main.findBrowserProfiles
- id: go-browser-extension-profiles-method
  desc: Extension profile search method reference
  crit: notable
  conf: 0.92
  if:
    type: text
    substr: main.getProfilesByExtension
composite_rules:
- id: go-browser-profile-discovery-methods
  desc: Multiple browser profile discovery method references
  crit: suspicious
  conf: 0.92
  needs: 3
  any:
  - id: micro-behaviors/fs/path/application/browser::go-browser-data-path-method
  - id: micro-behaviors/fs/path/application/browser::go-browser-browsers-method
  - id: micro-behaviors/fs/path/application/browser::go-browser-profiles-method
  - id: micro-behaviors/fs/path/application/browser::go-browser-extension-profiles-method
